document.abstract: This practice defines the spectral conditions defining the printing density gammas of motion-picture color negative and intermediate materials. It is not intended as a replacement for the status M density spectral conditions given in ANSI/ISO 5-3 and commonly used for the evaluation of color photographic materials used for printing.
